source: median dues of condos for sale in Horry County, ../invest-condos/listings.json
rule: IRS Pub. 527 (2025): rental share = days rented at a fair price / (those days + personal days); vacant days count for neither. Counts as a home if personal days > the greater of 14 or 10 percent of rented days; then rental deductions cannot exceed rental income.

cases.note: A main home: dues are not deductible (Pub. 530).

cases.case: Rented all year, no personal nights
cases.note: All of the dues are a rental expense, including weeks it sat empty while held for rent.
Counts as a home: 20 is more than 14 and more than 12 (10 percent of 120).
Does not count as a home: 14 is not more than 14.
Rented under 15 days: no rent reported, no rental deduction.
